sentences.text: It is stated that petitioners are licensed whole sale raw fish merchants doing business in the Sakthanthampuram public market maintained by the Municipal Corporation of Trichur.

Certain issues had arisen between retailers, who,
according to the petitioners, also started wholesale business.
This has resulted in law and order situation.
Though the petitioners approached the police seeking necessary protection, no action has been taken in the matter and hence the petitioners have approached this Court.
2. Counter affidavit has been filed by the 4th respondent inter alia
stating that separate areas and timings are alloted to both the groups regarding conduct of trade in the market.
Meetings were convened including whole sale traders and the issues had virtually been settled.
It is also stated that the Corporation is taking all earnest efforts to resolve the dispute between the rival traders.

3. Counter affidavit has been filed by the 1st respondent stating that there are more than 33 licensees conducting fish vending in the respective stalls, who had obtained necessary licence from the Municipality as well as from other competent authorities.
According to them, the intention in filing the writ petition is to prevent the respondents and their men from carrying on the fish vending activities as permitted under valid licence.
4. Facts being so, learned counsel for the petitioners submits that during the pendency of the writ petition, there was no untoward incident.
5. As far as the right of fish vending is concerned, it is for the Corporation to ensure that proper licensees are permitted to carry on the fish vending in terms of the licence.
Police cannot interfere in such issues.
Police can interfere only if there is any law and order situation.

6. In the result, this writ petition is closed as under; If there is any law and order situation, it shall be open for the petitioners to approach the police, in which event, police shall look into the matter and do the needful.

Sd/-
ASHOK BHUSHAN, CHIEF JUSTICE Sd/-
